name: starstruck
label: Starstruck
description: Four-pointed sparkles for eyes and a wide grin. Shows inline geometry: nothing here existed in either renderer's shape table.
_coordinates: Every point is relative to the part's own centre, in the browser page's 400x300 face box. An eye there is about 86 wide and 122 tall, a mouth about 112 wide — start from those and the proportions come out right on the panel too.
